turns.q: Is there anything I should pair it with to get the best result?
turns.replyTail:
The best pairing is the compatible Tumble Cushioned Rug Pad. If you choose a Rug & Pad Set, it’s already included, so you don’t need to add another product. The removable Rug Cover fits into the pad’s corner pockets, and the pad provides cushioning and a non-slip surface.

For the most stable feel, Tumble rugs and pads work best on hard floors. If you’re buying a Rug Cover on its own, make sure the pad is the same size.
